```{r prep metadata}
# Rename visits in overall table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Visit = as.character(Visit),
    Visit = case_when(
    Visit == "Healthy" ~ "Healthy",
    Visit == "V0" ~ "Baseline",
    Visit == "V1" ~ "Week 1",
    Visit == "V2" ~ "Week 2",
    Visit == "V3" ~ "Month 1-3",
    Visit == "V4" ~ "Month 4-6",
    Visit == "V5" ~ "Month 12",
    grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ Visit, #keep different X timepoints to not create duplicates
    TRUE~Visit
    ),
    Visit = factor(Visit,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4")) 
  )

# Assign unique sample IDs for each study ID
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Sample_ID = paste(Study_ID, Visit, sep = "_"))

# Create annotation table
table_lum_CarTrans_overall <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  mutate(Timepoint= case_when(grepl("^VX", Visit) ~ "Rejection Context",TRUE ~ Visit))

list_Timepoint <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%dplyr::select(Sample_ID, Visit, Timepoint)

 list_Timepoint$Timepoint = factor(list_Timepoint$Timepoint,levels = c("Healthy","Baseline","Week 1","Week 2","Month 1-3","Month 4-6","Month 12", "Rejection Context")) 

rownames(list_Timepoint) <- list_Timepoint$Sample_ID
list_Timepoint <- list_Timepoint[, c("Timepoint"), drop = FALSE] 
```

```{r prep lab}

table_lab <- table_lab %>%
  dplyr::select(-starts_with("Datelab_")) %>% #Exclude date of lab parameters for pivoting numeric values
  mutate(across(matches("_(BL|EMB[0-9X]+)$"), as.numeric)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = matches("_(BL|EMB[0-9X]+)$"),
               names_to = c(".value", "Visit"),

  mutate(
    Visit = recode(Visit,

      "EMBX2" = "VX2",
      "EMBX3" = "VX3",
      "EMBX4" = "VX4"),
    Visit = factor(Visit, levels = levels(table_lum_CarTrans_overall$Visit))
  )
```

# NTproBNP

```{r NTproBNP correlation, warning=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=15}
# Match Luminex and lab data per patient and visit
  table_corr <- inner_join(table_lum_CarTrans_overall, table_lab,
                           by = c("Study_ID", "Visit"))
# Order Timepoints
table_corr <- table_corr%>%
mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Healthy", "Baseline", "Week 1", "Week 2","Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12", "Rejection Context")))

# Define lab parameter (y axis)
  lab_param <- "NTproBNP"
  lab_label <- "NTproBNP (ng/l)"

# Define Luminex analytes (x axis)
  analytes <- c("PD_L1", "CXCL10", "IL2R", "Grem2")
  analyte_labels <- c("PD L1 (log pg/ml)", "CXCL10 (log pg/ml)", "IL2R (log pg/ml)", "Grem2 (log pg/ml)")
  names(analyte_labels) <- analytes

# Create list for plots
  plots_list <- list()

# Loop Correlation Plot
  for (p in analytes) 
    
    {
  
      # Compute Spearman correlation
        cor_test <- cor.test(table_corr[[p]], table_corr[[lab_param]], method = "spearman")
  
      # Define x axis margins and breaks
        max_x <- max(table_corr[[p]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
        min_x <- min(table_corr[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
        max_log10_limit <- 10^(ceiling(log10(max_x)))
        min_log10_limit <- 10^(floor(log10(min_x)))
        x_breaks <- 10^(seq(log10(min_log10_limit), log10(max_log10_limit), by = 1))
  
      # Scatter plot with regression line
        plot <- ggplot(table_corr, aes(x = .data[[p]], y = .data[[lab_param]])) +
                geom_point(aes(fill = Timepoint), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black",
                           position = position_jitter(width = 0.05, height = 0)) +
                geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black") +
                scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$Timepoint) +
                scale_x_log10(labels = function(y) format(y, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE), 
                              limits = c(min_log10_limit, max_log10_limit),
                              expand = c(0.05, 0), breaks = x_breaks) +
                theme_classic() +
                labs(x = analyte_labels[[p]], y = lab_label) +
                annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
                         label = paste0("r = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2),
                                        "\np = ", ifelse(cor_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", signif(cor_test$p.value, 3))),
                         hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 4)
        
      # Store each plot
        plots_list[[p]] <- plot

  }

# Combine plots to a panel
  panel <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                     common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
      
  print(panel)
```

```{r}
# Combine pathology and Luminex analytes
table_corr_path <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  inner_join(table_pathology %>% dplyr::select(ID, Visit, ISHLT_2004),
             by = c("Study_ID" = "ID", "Visit")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ISHLT_2004))

# Order Timepoints
table_corr_path <- table_corr_path%>%
mutate(Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = c("Week 1", "Week 2","Month 1-3", "Month 4-6", "Month 12", "Rejection Context")))
```

Testing for monotonous correlation ACR 0 - ACR 1R - ACR 2R - ACR 3R
- Rho (+): monotonous increase of analyte over increased grading (- decrease)

Caviat: Spearman assumes independent tests!

```{r}
# Correlation overall between pathological grading and target analytes

# Define Luminex analytes (y axis)
  analytes <- c("PD_L1", "CXCL10", "IL2R", "Grem2")
  analyte_labels <- c("PD L1 (log pg/ml)", "CXCL10 (log pg/ml)", "IL2R (log pg/ml)", "Grem2 (log pg/ml)")
  names(analyte_labels) <- analytes

# Create list for plots
  plots_list <- list()

# Loop Correlation Plot
  for (p in analytes) {

      # Spearman correlation with ordinal ISHLT grade
        cor_test <- cor.test(as.numeric(table_corr_path$ISHLT_2004), table_corr_path[[p]],
                             method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)

      # Define y axis margins and breaks
        max_y <- max(table_corr_path[[p]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
        min_y <- min(table_corr_path[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
        max_log10_limit <- 10^(ceiling(log10(max_y)))
        min_log10_limit <- 10^(floor(log10(min_y)))
        y_breaks <- 10^(seq(log10(min_log10_limit), log10(max_log10_limit), by = 1))

      # Box- and dotplot per ISHLT grade
        plot <- ggplot(table_corr_path, aes(x = ISHLT_2004, y = .data[[p]])) +
                geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, width = 0.5) +
                geom_point(aes(fill = Timepoint), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black",
                           position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)) +
                scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$Timepoint) +
                scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
                scale_y_log10(labels = function(y) format(y, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
                              limits = c(min_log10_limit, max_log10_limit),
                              expand = c(0.05, 0), breaks = y_breaks) +
                theme_classic() +
                labs(x = "ISHLT 2004", y = analyte_labels[[p]]) +
                annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
                         label = paste0("rho = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 2),
                                        "\np = ", ifelse(cor_test$p.value < 0.001, "< 0.001", signif(cor_test$p.value, 3))),
                         hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 4)

      # Store each plot
        plots_list[[p]] <- plot
  }

# Combine plots to a panel
  panel <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                     common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")

  print(panel)
```
```{r}
# Group for rejection vs no rejection
table_corr_path <- table_corr_path %>%
  mutate(Rejection = factor(ifelse(ISHLT_2004 %in% c("ACR 2R", "ACR 3R"), "Rejection", "No rejection"),
                            levels = c("No rejection", "Rejection")))

table(table_corr_path$Rejection)
```

```{r}
# Correlation over all visits 

plots_list <- list()

for (p in analytes) {

      # Linear mixed model: rejection vs no rejection, random intercept per patient
        fit <- lmer(as.formula(paste0("log10(", p, ") ~ Rejection + (1 | Study_ID)")),
                    data = table_corr_path)
        coef_rej <- summary(fit)$coefficients[2, ]

      # Define y axis margins and breaks
        max_y <- max(table_corr_path[[p]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
        min_y <- min(table_corr_path[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
        max_log10_limit <- 10^(ceiling(log10(max_y)))
        min_log10_limit <- 10^(floor(log10(min_y)))
        y_breaks <- 10^(seq(log10(min_log10_limit), log10(max_log10_limit), by = 1))

        plot <- ggplot(table_corr_path, aes(x = Rejection, y = .data[[p]])) +
                geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = NA, width = 0.5) +
                geom_point(aes(fill = Timepoint), shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black",
                           position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)) +
                scale_fill_manual(values = ann_colors$Timepoint) +
                scale_y_log10(labels = function(y) format(y, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
                              limits = c(min_log10_limit, max_log10_limit),
                              expand = c(0.05, 0), breaks = y_breaks) +
                theme_classic() +
                labs(x = "ACR ≥ 2R", y = analyte_labels[[p]]) +
                annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf,
                         label = paste0("FC = ", round(10^coef_rej["Estimate"], 2),
                                        "\np = ", ifelse(coef_rej["Pr(>|t|)"] < 0.001, "< 0.001",
                                                         signif(coef_rej["Pr(>|t|)"], 3))),
                         hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.2, size = 4)

        plots_list[[p]] <- plot
}

panel <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                   common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
print(panel)
```
```{r outcome late rejection}
# Outcome per patient: any rejection at late visits (from pathology, independent of Luminex availability)
outcome_late <- table_pathology %>%
  filter(Visit %in% c("Month 4-6", "Month 12", "VX1", "VX2", "VX3", "VX4"),
         !is.na(ISHLT_2004)) %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(Late_rejection = any(ISHLT_2004 %in% c("ACR 2R", "ACR 3R"))) %>%
  mutate(Late_rejection = factor(ifelse(Late_rejection, "Rejection", "No rejection"),
                                 levels = c("No rejection", "Rejection")))


# Early Luminex values with late outcome
table_early <- table_lum_CarTrans_overall %>%
  filter(Visit %in% c("Week 1", "Week 2", "Month 1-3")) %>%
  inner_join(outcome_late, by = c("Study_ID" = "ID")) %>%
  droplevels()

table(table_early$Visit, table_early$Late_rejection)
```
```{r early values vs late rejection, warning=FALSE}
plots_list <- list()

for (p in analytes) {

        max_y <- max(table_early[[p]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.1
        min_y <- min(table_early[[p]], na.rm = TRUE)
        max_log10_limit <- 10^(ceiling(log10(max_y)))
        min_log10_limit <- 10^(floor(log10(min_y)))
        y_breaks <- 10^(seq(log10(min_log10_limit), log10(max_log10_limit), by = 1))

        plot <- ggplot(table_early, aes(x = Visit, y = .data[[p]], fill = Late_rejection)) +
                geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.6, alpha = 0.4,
                             position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
                geom_point(shape = 21, size = 2.5, color = "black",
                           position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75)) +
                stat_compare_means(aes(group = Late_rejection), method = "wilcox.test",
                                   label = "p.format", size = 3.5) +
                scale_fill_manual(values = c("No rejection" = "grey80", "Rejection" = "#FF6B6B")) +
                scale_y_log10(labels = function(y) format(y, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE),
                              limits = c(min_log10_limit, max_log10_limit),
                              expand = c(0.05, 0), breaks = y_breaks) +
                theme_classic() +
                labs(x = NULL, y = analyte_labels[[p]], fill = "Rejection V4/V5/VX")

        plots_list[[p]] <- plot
}

panel <- ggarrange(plotlist = plots_list, ncol = 2, nrow = 2,
                   common.legend = TRUE, legend = "right")
print(panel)
```
